"""Read-only, scoped coverage. Unknown lifetime totals never become percentages."""
from sqlalchemy import and_, func, select, text
from db.models import Message, OfCreatorBinding
from db.onlyfans_models import OfIngress
from .history_policy import policy, OfOlderHistoryJob
from .store import utcnow


def recent_progress(s, runtime, fan_id=None):
    p = policy(s, runtime.account_id, runtime.binding_id)
    if p is None:
        return None
    from .launch_history_memory.recovery import OfRecentHistoryCursor as C, OfRecentHistoryScan
    filters = [C.account_id == runtime.account_id, C.binding_id == runtime.binding_id]
    scope = [Message.account_id == runtime.account_id, Message.created_at >= p.cutoff_at,
        select(OfIngress.event_key).where(OfIngress.account_id == Message.account_id,
            OfIngress.binding_id == runtime.binding_id, OfIngress.fan_id == Message.fan_id,
            OfIngress.message_id == Message.message_id, OfIngress.status == 'applied').exists()]
    if fan_id is not None:
        filters.append(C.fan_id == fan_id)
        scope.append(Message.fan_id == fan_id)
    counts = dict(s.execute(select(C.status, func.count()).where(*filters).group_by(C.status)).all())
    errors = dict(s.execute(select(C.last_error, func.count()).where(*filters,
        C.last_error.is_not(None)).group_by(C.last_error)).all())
    scan = s.get(OfRecentHistoryScan, runtime.account_id)
    discovery = bool(scan and scan.binding_id == runtime.binding_id and scan.status == 'complete'
                     and scan.known_fans_complete and not scan.last_error)
    # This state describes the initial import, including complete discovery.
    # One completed fan cannot make the account window ready while other
    # conversations are still being discovered (or satisfy the UI contract).
    covered = discovery and (bool(counts) if fan_id is not None else True) and not (
        counts.get('needed', 0) or counts.get('running', 0) or errors)
    total, fans, incoming = s.execute(select(func.count(), func.count(func.distinct(Message.fan_id)),
        func.count().filter(Message.direction == 'in')).where(*scope)).one()
    tenant = s.scalar(select(OfCreatorBinding.tenant_id).where(OfCreatorBinding.id==runtime.binding_id))
    params = {'tenant':tenant,'account':runtime.account_id,'binding':runtime.binding_id,'cutoff':p.cutoff_at,'fan':fan_id}
    # Same source-fingerprint receipts as the paid learner, including fact-free results.
    pending_sources = '''FROM messages m WHERE m.account_id=:account
        AND m.created_at>=:cutoff AND m.direction='in' AND (:fan IS NULL OR m.fan_id=:fan)
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_ingress i WHERE i.account_id=m.account_id AND i.binding_id=:binding
            AND i.fan_id=m.fan_id AND i.message_id=m.message_id AND i.status='applied')
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_profile_receipts r WHERE r.tenant_id=:tenant AND r.account_id=m.account_id
            AND r.binding_id=:binding AND r.fan_id=m.fan_id AND r.source_fan=m.fan_id
            AND r.message_id=m.message_id AND r.body_md5=md5(m.body) AND r.source_at=m.created_at
            AND r.direction=m.direction AND r.unsent=m.is_unsent AND r.automation=coalesce(m.automation_kind,'')
            AND r.next_chunk=r.total_chunks)'''
    pending = s.scalar(text('SELECT count(*) ' + pending_sources),params)
    old = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(OfOlderHistoryJob).where(
        OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id == runtime.account_id, OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id == runtime.binding_id,
        True if fan_id is None else OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id == fan_id))
    from .launch_history_memory.recovery import OfHistoryCursor as L, OfHistoryScan
    lifetime_scan = s.get(OfHistoryScan, runtime.account_id)
    lifetime_states = dict(s.execute(select(L.status,func.count()).where(
        L.account_id==runtime.account_id,L.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,
        True if fan_id is None else L.fan_id==fan_id).group_by(L.status)).all())
    lifetime_complete = bool(lifetime_states) and not (lifetime_states.get('needed',0) or lifetime_states.get('running',0))
    if fan_id is None:
        from db.models import Fan
        missing = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Fan).where(Fan.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            ~select(L.fan_id).where(L.account_id==Fan.account_id,L.fan_id==Fan.fan_id,L.binding_id==runtime.binding_id).exists()))
        lifetime_complete = bool(lifetime_complete and lifetime_scan and lifetime_scan.status=='complete'
            and lifetime_scan.known_fans_complete and not missing)
    older_done = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(OfOlderHistoryJob).join(L,and_(
        L.account_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id,L.fan_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id,
        L.binding_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id)).where(OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id==runtime.account_id,
        OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,L.status=='complete',
        True if fan_id is None else OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id==fan_id))
    hold = s.execute(text('''SELECT hold_code,hold_until FROM of_profile_accounts
        WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND account_id=:account AND binding_id=:binding'''),params).first()
    active_hold = bool(hold and hold[1] and str(hold[1]) > str(utcnow()))
    # Historical failures remain stored, but only failures with unprocessed
    # current-window sources can block recent memory readiness.
    memory_errors, deferred_errors = s.execute(text(f"""SELECT
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE fan_id IN (SELECT m.fan_id {pending_sources})),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE fan_id NOT IN (SELECT m.fan_id {pending_sources}))
        FROM of_profile_learning WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND account_id=:account
        AND binding_id=:binding AND fan_id>0 AND (:fan IS NULL OR fan_id=:fan)
        AND error_code IS NOT NULL"""),params).one()
    from .history_telemetry import OfHistoryReadAttempt as A
    attempts, http_attempts, failed, unfinished = s.execute(select(func.count(),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(A.http_attempts),0),func.count().filter(A.outcome=='failed'),
        func.count().filter(A.outcome=='unfinished')).where(A.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            A.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,A.scope=='recent',
            True if fan_id is None else A.fan_id==fan_id)).one()
    from db.models import GrokCall
    from .profile_learning.accounting import metadata
    from decimal import Decimal
    billing = {k:0 for k in ['providerReportedUnits','tokenEstimateUnits','activeReservationUnits','unresolvedReservationUnits']}
    model_ms = 0
    for call in s.scalars(select(GrokCall).where(GrokCall.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            GrokCall.purpose=='gen_info',GrokCall.called_at>=p.started_at,
            True if fan_id is None else GrokCall.fan_id==fan_id)):
        meta = metadata(call)
        bucket = ('activeReservationUnits' if call.status=='pending' else
            'unresolvedReservationUnits' if call.status=='unknown' else
            'providerReportedUnits' if meta.get('billing') in {'provider_reported_cost','provider_reconciled'} else 'tokenEstimateUnits')
        billing[bucket] += call.cost_cents or 0
        model_ms += call.latency_ms or 0
    accounting = {k.replace('Units','Usd'):str(Decimal(v)/10000) for k,v in billing.items()}
    receipt_first, receipt_last = s.execute(text("""SELECT min(processed_at),max(processed_at) FROM of_profile_receipts
        WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND account_id=:account AND binding_id=:binding AND fan_id>0
        AND source_at>=:cutoff AND processed_at>=:started AND (:fan IS NULL OR fan_id=:fan)"""),{**params,'started':p.started_at}).one()
    accounting.update(scope='account memory calls since fixed policy start, including activated older jobs',
        cumulativeModelCallMilliseconds=model_ms)
    completed_at = s.scalar(select(func.max(C.completed_at)).where(*filters)) if covered else None
    from .history_policy import approved_onboarding
    onboarding = approved_onboarding(s, runtime.account_id, runtime.binding_id)
    return {'creatorOnboarding':{'state':'approved' if onboarding else 'review_required','routineCreatorArchiveExtraction':'disabled'},
        'schemaVersion':'of-recent-history.v1', 'startedAt':p.started_at.isoformat()+'Z',
        'cutoffAt':p.cutoff_at.isoformat()+'Z', 'retentionPolicy':'preserve_all_stored_data',
        'initialHistory':{'state':'recent_history_ready' if covered else 'incomplete',
            'discoveryComplete':discovery,'discoveryPasses':scan.pass_number if scan else 0,
            'discoveryError':scan.last_error if scan else None,
            'conversationsDiscovered':sum(counts.values()),'conversationsReady':counts.get('complete',0),
            'conversationsAwaitingWork':counts.get('needed',0)+counts.get('running',0),
            'messagesSavedInWindow':total,'fansWithStoredWindowMessages':fans,'providerErrors':errors,
            'completedAt':completed_at.isoformat()+'Z' if completed_at else None,
            'elapsedSeconds':max(0,((completed_at or utcnow())-p.started_at).total_seconds()),
            'providerOrdering':'verified_timestamp_desc' if p.timestamp_order_verified else 'id_desc_exhaustive_date_filter',
            'orderingEvidence':p.ordering_evidence,
            'providerRequests':int(http_attempts), 'pageReadAttempts':attempts, 'failedReadAttempts':failed,
            'unfinishedReadAttempts':unfinished, 'providerRequestMeasurement':'HTTP attempts counted at dispatch, including identity probes and failures'},
        'memoryProcessing':{'state':'ready' if covered and pending==0 and not active_hold and not memory_errors else 'incomplete',
            'incomingMessagesInWindow':incoming,'messagesProcessed':incoming-pending,'messagesAwaitingProcessing':pending,
            'firstCurrentRunReceiptAt':str(receipt_first) if receipt_first else None,
            'lastCurrentRunReceiptAt':str(receipt_last) if receipt_last else None,
            'receiptIntervalMeasurement':'wall interval between committed memory receipts; cumulative model latency is separate',
            'errors':memory_errors, 'errorsOutsidePendingRecentWork':deferred_errors, 'budgetHold':hold[0] if active_hold else None,
            'completionDoesNotMeanLifetimeHistory':True},
        'memoryModelAccounting':accounting,
        'lifetimeHistory':{'complete':lifetime_complete,'conversationsComplete':lifetime_states.get('complete',0)},
        'olderHistory':{'activatedFanJobs':old,'completedFanJobs':older_done,'pendingFanJobs':old-older_done,'scheduler':'bounded existing archive lane'},
        'lifetimeTotalMessages':None,'percentComplete':None}

"""Read-only private snapshots separate reused work from a subsequent pilot run.

Snapshots contain source fingerprints and call IDs, never message text. Keep them
on the operational host. No model/provider requests, activation, DDL or deletion.
"""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import func, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from db.models import Message, GrokCall
from db.onlyfans_models import OfIngress
from onlyfans_runtime.history_policy import policy
from onlyfans_runtime.history_telemetry import OfHistoryReadAttempt
from onlyfans_runtime.profile_learning.accounting import metadata
from onlyfans_runtime.store import Store, Refused

SCHEMA = 'of-history-pilot-snapshot.v1'


def capture(store, tenant, account):
    with store.engine.connect().execution_options(isolation_level='REPEATABLE READ') as connection:
        with Session(bind=connection) as s, s.begin():
            runtime = store._runtime(s, tenant, account, lock=False)
            p = policy(s, account, runtime.binding_id)
            if p is None: raise Refused('recent-history policy is not active')
            scope = [Message.account_id == account, Message.created_at >= p.cutoff_at,
                select(OfIngress.event_key).where(OfIngress.account_id == account,
                    OfIngress.binding_id == runtime.binding_id, OfIngress.status == 'applied',
                    OfIngress.fan_id == Message.fan_id, OfIngress.message_id == Message.message_id).exists()]
            sources = {}
            for fan, mid, at, direction, unsent, automation, body_hash in s.execute(select(
                    Message.fan_id, Message.message_id, Message.created_at, Message.direction,
                    Message.is_unsent, Message.automation_kind, func.md5(Message.body)).where(*scope)):
                key = hashlib.sha256(f'{account}:{fan}:{mid}'.encode()).hexdigest()
                digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([str(at), direction, unsent, automation or '', body_hash]).encode()).hexdigest()
                sources[key] = digest
            # The same fingerprint conditions used by the paid learner and progress report.
            receipts = {}
            for fan, mid, at in s.execute(text('''SELECT m.fan_id,m.message_id,r.processed_at
                FROM messages m JOIN of_profile_receipts r ON r.tenant_id=:tenant AND r.account_id=m.account_id
                AND r.binding_id=:binding AND r.fan_id=m.fan_id AND r.source_fan=m.fan_id
                AND r.message_id=m.message_id AND r.body_md5=md5(m.body) AND r.source_at=m.created_at
                AND r.direction=m.direction AND r.unsent=m.is_unsent
                AND r.automation=coalesce(m.automation_kind,'') AND r.next_chunk=r.total_chunks
                WHERE m.account_id=:account AND m.created_at>=:cutoff AND m.direction='in'
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_ingress i WHERE i.account_id=m.account_id
                    AND i.binding_id=:binding AND i.fan_id=m.fan_id AND i.message_id=m.message_id
                    AND i.status='applied')'''), {'tenant':tenant,'account':account,'binding':runtime.binding_id,'cutoff':p.cutoff_at}):
                key = hashlib.sha256(f'{account}:{fan}:{mid}'.encode()).hexdigest()
                receipts[key] = {'digest': sources[key], 'committedAt': str(at)}
            calls = {}
            for call in s.scalars(select(GrokCall).where(GrokCall.account_id == account, GrokCall.purpose == 'gen_info')):
                billing = metadata(call).get('billing')
                bucket = ('activeReservationUnits' if call.status == 'pending' else
                    'unresolvedReservationUnits' if call.status == 'unknown' else
                    'providerReportedUnits' if billing in {'provider_reported_cost','provider_reconciled'} else 'tokenEstimateUnits')
                calls[str(call.id)] = {'bucket':bucket,'units':call.cost_cents or 0,'latencyMs':call.latency_ms or 0}
            attempts = s.scalar(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(OfHistoryReadAttempt.http_attempts),0)).where(
                OfHistoryReadAttempt.account_id == account, OfHistoryReadAttempt.binding_id == runtime.binding_id,
                OfHistoryReadAttempt.scope == 'recent'))
            return {'schemaVersion':SCHEMA,'observedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                'accountId':account,'bindingId':runtime.binding_id,'cutoffAt':p.cutoff_at.isoformat(),
                'sources':sources,'receipts':receipts,'modelCalls':calls,'recentHttpAttempts':int(attempts)}


def compare(before, after):
    for key in ['schemaVersion','accountId','bindingId','cutoffAt']:
        if before.get(key) != after.get(key): raise ValueError('snapshot scope changed: '+key)
    if before.get('schemaVersion') != SCHEMA: raise ValueError('invalid snapshot schema')
    start,end = (datetime.fromisoformat(x['observedAt']) for x in [before,after])
    if end < start: raise ValueError('snapshots reversed')
    old,new = before['sources'],after['sources']
    old_r,new_r = before['receipts'],after['receipts']
    reused = {k for k,v in new.items() if old.get(k) == v}
    completed = {k for k,v in new_r.items() if old_r.get(k,{}).get('digest') != v['digest']}
    changed_old_calls = {k for k,v in after['modelCalls'].items() if k in before['modelCalls'] and before['modelCalls'][k] != v}
    new_calls = {k:v for k,v in after['modelCalls'].items() if k not in before['modelCalls']}
    def totals(calls):
        result = {k:0 for k in ['providerReportedUnits','tokenEstimateUnits','activeReservationUnits','unresolvedReservationUnits']}
        for c in calls: result[c['bucket']] += c['units']
        return result
    committed = [datetime.fromisoformat(new_r[k]['committedAt']) for k in completed]
    previous = totals(before['modelCalls'][k] for k in changed_old_calls)
    current = totals(after['modelCalls'][k] for k in changed_old_calls)
    return {'schemaVersion':'of-history-pilot-comparison.v1','accountId':after['accountId'],
        'basis':'Observed pilot with reused archive; not fresh creator onboarding performance',
        'observedElapsedSeconds':(end-start).total_seconds(),
        'existingWindowSourcesAtStart':len(old),'unchangedExistingWindowSourcesReused':len(reused),
        'newWindowSourcesSaved':len(set(new)-set(old)),
        'existingWindowSourcesEdited':sum(k in old and old[k]!=v for k,v in new.items()),
        'baselineSourcesNoLongerInScope':len(set(old)-set(new)),
        'reusedCompletedIncomingReceipts':sum(old_r.get(k,{}).get('digest')==v['digest'] for k,v in new_r.items()),
        'newlyCompletedIncomingReceipts':len(completed),
        'newlyCompletedReceiptsForReusedSources':len(completed & reused),
        'newReceiptCommitSpanSeconds':(max(committed)-min(committed)).total_seconds() if committed else None,
        'receiptSpanIsNotTotalMemoryProcessingTime':True,
        'newRecentProviderHttpAttempts':after['recentHttpAttempts']-before['recentHttpAttempts'],
        'newModelCalls':len(new_calls),'newModelCallAmounts':totals(new_calls.values()),
        'amountUsdPerUnit':'0.0001',
        'preExistingModelCallSettlementChanges':{k:current[k]-previous[k] for k in current},
        'cumulativeNewModelCallLatencyMs':sum(c['latencyMs'] for c in new_calls.values()),
        'newSourcesIncludeConcurrentLiveArrivals':True,
        'fullHistoryTimeOrCostSavingsDemonstrated':False}


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--account', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--save-snapshot', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--compare-with', type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    before=json.loads(args.compare_with.read_text()) if args.compare_with else None
    store=Store(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])
    try: snapshot=capture(store,os.environ['ONLYFANS_WORKER_TENANT'],args.account)
    finally: store.close()
    # Exclusive creation prevents accidental destruction of the before evidence.
    fd=os.open(args.save_snapshot,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as stream: json.dump(snapshot,stream)
    print(json.dumps(compare(before,snapshot) if before else {
        'accountId':args.account,'baselineCaptured':True,'windowSources':len(snapshot['sources']),
        'completedIncomingReceipts':len(snapshot['receipts']),'modelCallRecords':len(snapshot['modelCalls'])},indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': main()

"""Dedicated bounded archive pool. Uses the same durable provider budget as live work."""
import concurrent.futures as futures
import json
import os
import signal
import threading
import time

from .import_capacity import capacity


def _transient_database_error(exc):
    from sqlalchemy.exc import DBAPIError
    if not isinstance(exc, DBAPIError):
        return False
    code = getattr(exc.orig, 'pgcode', None)
    return (exc.connection_invalidated or code in {'55P03', '57014', '40001', '40P01'}
            or isinstance(code, str) and code.startswith('08'))


def run(store, tenant, accounts, stop, *, workers=64, refresh=None):
    """I/O concurrency across fans; cursors and session fences remain in HistoryRecovery.

    ``accounts`` contains only explicitly configured creator IDs. Refresh is invoked
    only in the coordinator; workers never load or mutate credentials.
    """
    from .launch_history_memory.recovery import HistoryRecovery
    if type(workers) is not int or not 1 <= workers <= 256:
        raise ValueError('history workers must be 1–256')
    recovery = HistoryRecovery(store)
    active, next_at, scanning, last_scan = {}, {}, set(), {}
    refresh_due = time.monotonic() + (60 if accounts else 0)
    refresh_failures = 0
    seed_failures = {}
    with futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        while not stop.is_set():
            now = time.monotonic()
            for task in list(active):
                if not task.done():
                    continue
                account, discovery = active.pop(task)
                if discovery:
                    scanning.discard(account)
                try:
                    pages = task.result()
                    state = 'progress' if pages else 'waiting'
                    if not pages:
                        next_at[account] = max(next_at.get(account, 0), now + .25)
                    error = None
                except Exception as exc:
                    pages, state, error = 0, 'deferred', type(exc).__name__
                    next_at[account] = max(next_at.get(account, 0), now + 1)
                print(json.dumps({'component':'parallel-history','account':account,
                    'state':state,'pages':pages,'errorType':error}), flush=True)
            if refresh is not None and now >= refresh_due:
                try:
                    accounts = refresh()
                except Exception as exc:
                    if not _transient_database_error(exc):
                        raise
                    # No new reads may use a cohort whose credentials could
                    # not be refreshed. Already admitted reads retain their
                    # existing durable generation and provider fences.
                    accounts = {}
                    refresh_failures = min(refresh_failures + 1, 7)
                    delay = min(60, 2 ** (refresh_failures - 1))
                    print(json.dumps({'component':'parallel-history','state':'cohort_refresh_deferred',
                        'errorType':type(exc).__name__,'retrySeconds':delay}), flush=True)
                else:
                    refresh_failures, delay = 0, 60
                refresh_due = time.monotonic() + delay
            if stop.is_set():
                break
            counts = {}
            for account, _ in active.values():
                counts[account] = counts.get(account, 0) + 1
            # Rotate iteration order after each submission using next_at, so a
            # large first account cannot occupy every global worker indefinitely.
            for account in sorted(accounts, key=lambda a: next_at.get(a, 0)):
                if len(active) >= workers:
                    break
                policy = capacity(account)
                if now < next_at.get(account, 0) or counts.get(account, 0) >= max(1,policy.inflight-1):
                    continue
                bound = accounts[account]
                revision = bound.read_connection_revision or getattr(bound.reader, 'connection_revision', None)
                discovery = account not in scanning and now-last_scan.get(account, -60) >= 2
                if discovery:
                    # One coordinator owns seeding/discovery for each account.
                    try:
                        recovery.request_account(tenant, account, connection_revision=revision)
                    except Exception as exc:
                        if not _transient_database_error(exc):
                            raise
                        failures = min(seed_failures.get(account, 0) + 1, 7)
                        seed_failures[account] = failures
                        delay = min(60, 2 ** (failures - 1))
                        next_at[account] = now + delay
                        print(json.dumps({'component':'parallel-history','account':account,
                            'state':'discovery_deferred','errorType':type(exc).__name__,
                            'retrySeconds':delay}), flush=True)
                        continue
                    seed_failures.pop(account, None)
                    scanning.add(account)
                    last_scan[account] = now
                task = pool.submit(recovery.step, tenant, account, bound.reader,
                    connection_revision=revision, archive_only=not discovery)
                active[task] = account, discovery
                next_at[account] = now + 1 / policy.rps
            stop.wait(.01)
        # Let bounded outstanding reads settle before disposing the database pool.
        for task in active:
            try:
                task.result()
            except Exception:
                pass


def main():
    tenant = os.environ.get('ONLYFANS_WORKER_TENANT', '')
    if (os.environ.get('ONLYFANS_PROCESS_ROLE') != 'worker' or not tenant or tenant == 'deployment'
            or os.environ.get('ONLYFANS_PARALLEL_IMPORT_ENABLED') != '1'):
        raise SystemExit('explicit worker tenant and parallel import enablement required')
    configured = json.loads(os.environ.get('ONLYFANS_IMPORT_CAPACITY', '{}'))
    from .history_policy import automatic_new_accounts
    if not isinstance(configured, dict) or (not configured and not automatic_new_accounts()):
        raise SystemExit('explicit account capacity map or new-account rollout required')
    for account in configured:
        capacity(account)
    from .store import Store
    from .connections import load_worker_cohort
    store = Store(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'], pool_size=16)
    stop = threading.Event()
    for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
        signal.signal(sig, lambda *_: stop.set())
    def refresh():
        result, cursor = {}, None
        while not stop.is_set():
            rows, cursor, _ = load_worker_cohort(store, tenant, after_account=cursor,
                stop=stop, include_read_only=True)
            # Explicit capacity overrides remain unchanged. Newly enrolled
            # accounts use the existing conservative default governor limits.
            from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
            from .history_policy import automatic_new_accounts, policy
            with Session(store.engine) as session:
                for account in rows:
                    if account.account_id in configured or (automatic_new_accounts()
                            and policy(session,account.account_id) is not None):
                        result[account.account_id] = account
            if cursor is None:
                return result
        return result
    try:
        run(store, tenant, {}, stop,
            workers=int(os.environ.get('ONLYFANS_IMPORT_WORKERS', '64')), refresh=refresh)
    finally:
        store.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Explicit scoped credential storage and worker-side provider verification.

Credentials are encrypted with an operator-owned key. API commands never make
provider requests, and uploading a capture never enables outgoing messages.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

# The stored deadline is a renewable verification lease, not a forced logout.
# Short in-memory transport deadlines and all existing send gates remain intact.
CONNECTION_LEASE = timedelta(hours=6)
CONNECTION_CHECK_INTERVAL = timedelta(minutes=15)
CONNECTION_RETRY_INTERVAL = timedelta(minutes=1)

def encryption_key():
    raw=os.environ.get('ONLYFANS_CONNECTION_KEY','')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-fA-F0-9]{64}',raw):raise Refused('connection encryption is not configured')
    return bytes.fromhex(raw)

def _aad(tenant,account,binding,revision):
    return canonical([tenant,account,binding,revision]).encode()

def _seal(value,tenant,account,binding,revision):
    nonce=os.urandom(12)
    return base64.b64encode(nonce+AESGCM(encryption_key()).encrypt(nonce,canonical(value).encode(),_aad(tenant,account,binding,revision))).decode()

def _open(row,tenant):
    try:
        raw=base64.b64decode(row.sealed_config,validate=True)
        value=json.loads(AESGCM(encryption_key()).decrypt(raw[:12],raw[12:],_aad(tenant,row.account_id,row.binding_id,row.revision)))
        saved_expiry=datetime.fromisoformat(value['expiresAt'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
        if (value['ownerId']!=row.owner_id or saved_expiry.tzinfo is None
            or saved_expiry.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)!=row.expires_at):raise ValueError()
        return value
    except Exception:
        raise Refused('stored connection credentials are unavailable') from None

def _request(action,payload,expected_revision):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical({'action':action,'payload':payload,'expectedRevision':expected_revision}).encode()).hexdigest()

def _audit(s,row,key,actor,action,fingerprint):
    s.add(OfConnectionChange(account_id=row.account_id,command_key=key,revision=row.revision,
        action=action,request_hash=fingerprint,actor=actor,created_at=utcnow()))

def _validate_identity(key,actor,revision):
    from onlyfans_read.agency_scope import ACTOR_PATTERN
    # Agency-user actors reach here only through the control-purpose activation command, which also checks
    # the agency's manage permission and creator scope (Store._runtime) before any change.
    if (type(key) is not str or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{64}',key) or type(actor) is not str
        or not re.fullmatch(rf'(?:op-session|creator-session):[a-f0-9]{{64}}|{ACTOR_PATTERN}',actor) or type(revision) is not int or not 0<=revision<2**31-1):
        raise Refused('invalid connection command')

def provision_account(store,tenant,*,creator_id,creator_name,owner_id,handle,command_key,actor):
    """Create a new scoped account disabled. Existing legacy accounts are never adopted."""
    _validate_identity(command_key,actor,0)
    try:
        valid=(type(tenant) is str and tenant!='deployment' and bool(ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(tenant))
            and type(owner_id) is int and 0<owner_id<2**63 and type(creator_id) is str and bool(ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(creator_id))
            and type(creator_name) is str and bool(creator_name.strip()) and '\x00' not in creator_name and len(creator_name.encode())<=160
            and type(handle) is str and '\x00' not in handle and len(handle.encode())<=160)
    except UnicodeError:valid=False
    if not valid:raise Refused('invalid account registration')
    account='of-'+str(owner_id)
    binding_id=str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL,canonical([tenant,creator_id,account,command_key])))
    fingerprint=_request('provision',{'creatorId':creator_id,'creatorName':creator_name,'ownerId':owner_id,'handle':handle},0)
    with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
        # The account does not yet have a runtime row to lock. Serialize its
        # creation so identical concurrent commands return the same event.
        lock=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(account.encode()).digest()[:8],'big',signed=True)
        s.execute(text('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(:key)'),{'key':lock})
        existing=s.get(Account,account)
        if existing is not None:
            binding=s.scalar(select(OfCreatorBinding).where(OfCreatorBinding.id==binding_id,
                OfCreatorBinding.account_id==account,OfCreatorBinding.tenant_id==tenant,OfCreatorBinding.revoked_at.is_(None)))
            prior=s.get(OfConnectionChange,(account,command_key))
            if (binding is None or binding.creator_id!=creator_id or prior is None or prior.action!='provision'
                or prior.request_hash!=fingerprint or prior.actor!=actor):raise Refused('account registration conflict')
            return account
        s.add(Account(id=account,nickname=creator_name));s.flush()
        s.add(OfCreatorBinding(id=binding_id,tenant_id=tenant,creator_id=creator_id,creator_name=creator_name,
            account_id=account,handle=handle,channel='onlyfans'));s.flush()
        runtime=OfRuntime(account_id=account,binding_id=binding_id,activated_at=utcnow(),enabled=False)
        s.add(runtime);s.flush()
        from .history_policy import ensure
        ensure(s,runtime,new_account=True)
        from .contextual_mode import new_account_settings
        s.add(AccountAiConfig(account_id=account,
            ai_chatter_config_json=canonical(new_account_settings())));s.flush()
        s.add(OfConnectionChange(account_id=account,command_key=command_key,revision=0,action='provision',
            request_hash=fingerprint,actor=actor,created_at=utcnow()))
    return account

def capture_network_fingerprint(proxy):
    return hashlib.sha256(('twin-capture-network.v1\x00'+(proxy or '')).encode()).hexdigest()


def get_capture_context(store,tenant,creator,account=None):
    """Private server-to-server login context, never a creator status response."""
    if (type(creator)is not str or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(creator)
            or type(tenant)is not str or tenant=='deployment' or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(tenant)):
        raise Refused('scope unavailable')
    proxy=None;owner=None
    if account is not None:
        if type(account)is not str or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(account):raise Refused('scope unavailable')
        with Session(store.engine) as s:
            runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account)
            binding=s.get(OfCreatorBinding,runtime.binding_id)
            if binding is None or binding.creator_id!=creator or binding.revoked_at is not None:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
            match=re.fullmatch(r'of-([1-9][0-9]{0,15})',account)
            if match is None:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
            owner=int(match[1])
            row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
            if row is not None:
                if row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
                clear=_open(row,tenant);proxy=clear['proxyUrl'];owner=row.owner_id
    return {'accountId':account,'ownerId':owner,'proxyUrl':proxy,'fingerprint':capture_network_fingerprint(proxy)}


def get_connection(store,tenant,account,*,include_sync=False,include_runner=False,include_policy=False,include_recent=False,runner_status_path=None):
    with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
        runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account)
        row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account);policy=s.get(OfDeliveryPolicy,account)
        if row is not None and row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
        now=utcnow()
        credentials_valid=True
        if row is not None and row.expires_at>now:
            try:_open(row,tenant)
            except Refused:credentials_valid=False
        result={'accountId':account,'revision':row.revision if row else 0,
            'status':('expired' if row and row.expires_at<=now and row.status not in {'paused','failed'} else row.status if credentials_valid else 'failed') if row else 'unconfigured',
            'ownerId':str(row.owner_id) if row else None,'expiresAt':row.expires_at.isoformat()+'Z' if row else None,
            'verifiedAt':row.verified_at.isoformat()+'Z' if row and row.verified_at else None,
            'lastError':('stored_credentials_unavailable' if not credentials_valid else row.last_error) if row else None,
            'outgoingEnabled':bool(row and credentials_valid and row.expires_at>now and row.status=='verified' and runtime.enabled and policy and policy.enabled and policy.transport_kind=='native'),
            'policyRevision':policy.revision if policy else 0,'usedUnits':policy.used_units if policy else 0,
            'limitUnits':policy.limit_units if policy else 0,'mediaEnabled':bool(policy and policy.media_enabled),
            'automateNewConversations':bool(row and row.automate_new_conversations and not NEW_CONVERSATION_AUTOMATION_LOCKED)}
        recent = None
        if include_sync or include_recent:
            from .history_progress import recent_progress
            recent = recent_progress(s, runtime)
            # Existing dashboard clients enforce exact connection keys.
            # Only callers explicitly negotiating recent history receive it.
            if include_recent and recent is not None:
                result['recentHistory'] = recent
        if include_policy:
            result['throttleSeconds']=policy.throttle_seconds if policy else None
        if include_runner:
            # Connected is not live. Report the supervisor's runner state separately; the file is only read,
            # a missing file is 'unknown', and aiLive needs sending enabled AND a running runner.
            from .runner_state import runner_state
            result['runner']=runner_state(account,path=runner_status_path)
            result['aiLive']=bool(result['outgoingEnabled'] and result['runner']['state']=='running')
        if include_sync:
            scan=s.get(OfScan,account)
            recovery=dict(s.execute(select(OfRecovery.status,func.count()).where(OfRecovery.account_id==account).group_by(OfRecovery.status)).all())
            quarantined=s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(OfIngress).where(OfIngress.account_id==account,OfIngress.status=='quarantined'))
            result['sync']={'discoveryStatus':scan.status if scan else 'not_started','pages':scan.page_count if scan else 0,
                'conversationsComplete':recovery.get('complete',0),'conversationsRemaining':sum(count for state,count in recovery.items() if state!='complete'),
                'pendingMessages':runtime.pending_events,'quarantinedMessages':quarantined,'recoveryRequired':runtime.recovery_needed,
                'lastCompleteSyncAt':runtime.last_sync_at.isoformat()+'Z' if runtime.last_sync_at else None}
            if recent is not None and not recent['lifetimeHistory']['complete']:
                # The old UI's "Last import complete" condition must not be
                # satisfied by a completed recent-window/live catch-up pass.
                result['sync']['recoveryRequired'] = True
                result['sync']['lastCompleteSyncAt'] = None
        return result

def personality_credential_status(s,account,binding_id,*,_unavailable_as_none=False,_lock_runtime=True):
    """Read non-secret readiness through the existing credential authority.

    The personality callback already runs inside its scoped transaction. Resolve
    that same live binding, then use the normal runtime/agency guard before
    opening encrypted data. This projection never verifies with a provider,
    renews a lease, enables sending, or consults environment model credentials.
    """
    from .store import Store
    from model_selection import explicit_model
    from llm_models import MODELS

    if (type(account) is not str or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(account)
            or type(binding_id) is not str or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(binding_id)):
        raise Refused('scope unavailable')
    binding=s.get(OfCreatorBinding,binding_id)
    if (binding is None or binding.account_id!=account or binding.channel!='onlyfans'
            or binding.revoked_at is not None or type(binding.tenant_id) is not str
            or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(binding.tenant_id)):
        raise Refused('scope unavailable')
    runtime=Store._runtime(s,binding.tenant_id,account,lock=_lock_runtime)
    if runtime.binding_id!=binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
    config=s.get(AccountAiConfig,account)
    try:selected=explicit_model(config,'ai_chatter',MODELS)
    except (ValueError,TypeError,RecursionError):selected=''
    metadata={'accountId':account,'modelId':'','configured':False,
        'expiresAt':'1970-01-01T00:00:00Z'}
    row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
    if row is None or row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:
        return None if _unavailable_as_none else metadata
    metadata['expiresAt']=row.expires_at.isoformat()+'Z'
    if (not selected or row.status!='verified' or row.verified_at is None
            or row.last_error is not None or row.expires_at<=utcnow()):return metadata
    try:clear=_open(row,binding.tenant_id)
    except Refused:
        return None if _unavailable_as_none else metadata
    try:
        model=clear.get('model')
        if (type(model) is not dict or set(model)!={'modelId','apiKey'}
                or type(model['modelId']) is not str):return metadata
        # Validate the same explicit registry/credential/deadline requirements
        # as the native adapter without constructing a model or provider client.
        from llm_client import _resolve
        from .provider_connector import _deadline, _header
        import httpx
        _,provider=_resolve(model['modelId'])
        endpoint=httpx.URL(provider.base_url.rstrip('/')+'/chat/completions')
        if (endpoint.scheme!='https' or endpoint.username or endpoint.password
                or endpoint.query or endpoint.fragment):return metadata
        _header(model['apiKey'],'model credential',4096)
        _deadline(row.expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        metadata['modelId']=model['modelId']
        # "configured" means this exact scoped key is stored and valid. The
        # readiness policy compares this actual modelId with the saved/reviewed
        # selection and reports model_mismatch; presence never means usable.
        metadata['configured']=True
    except Exception:
        # Ciphertext/key/shape errors are readiness failures. Never expose the
        # decryption error or a credential-derived exception in an API result.
        return metadata
    return metadata

def save_connection(store,tenant,account,*,payload,expected_revision,command_key,actor,session_only=False,expected_network_fingerprint=None):
    _validate_identity(command_key,actor,expected_revision)
    required={'ownerId','capture','xHash','expiresAt'} if session_only else {'ownerId','capture','xHash','proxyUrl','expiresAt','model'}
    if type(payload) is not dict or set(payload)!=required:raise Refused('invalid connection configuration')
    action='session' if session_only else 'save'
    fingerprint=_request(action,payload,expected_revision)
    with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
        runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account)
        prior=s.get(OfConnectionChange,(account,command_key))
        if prior:
            if prior.request_hash!=fingerprint or prior.actor!=actor:raise Refused('connection idempotency conflict')
            return prior.revision
        row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
        if row is not None and row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
        if (row.revision if row else 0)!=expected_revision:raise Refused('connection revision conflict')
        if row is not None and row.owner_id!=payload['ownerId']:raise Refused('connection owner cannot change')
        if session_only:
            # A creator refreshes authentication only. Keep operator-owned network
            # and model settings inside the encrypted store, never in a response.
            previous=_open(row,tenant) if row is not None else {}
            if expected_network_fingerprint is not None and expected_network_fingerprint!=capture_network_fingerprint(previous.get('proxyUrl')):
                raise Refused('capture network changed')
            payload={**payload,'proxyUrl':previous.get('proxyUrl'),'model':previous.get('model')}
        try:
            expires=datetime.fromisoformat(payload['expiresAt'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
            session_from_capture(account_id=account,owner_id=payload['ownerId'],policy_revision=1,capture=payload['capture'],
                x_hash=payload['xHash'],proxy_url=payload['proxyUrl'],expires_at=expires)
            model=payload['model']
            if model is not None:
                if type(model) is not dict or set(model)!={'modelId','apiKey'}:raise Refused('invalid selected model credential')
                from .provider_model import NativeProviderModel
                NativeProviderModel(account_id=account,model_id=model['modelId'],api_key=model['apiKey'],expires_at=expires)
        except Exception:raise Refused('invalid connection configuration') from None
        from managed_proxy.reservation import reserve_network
        from managed_proxy.provider import ProxyError
        binding=s.get(OfCreatorBinding,runtime.binding_id)
        try:reserve_network(s,tenant,binding.creator_id,payload['proxyUrl'],encryption_key(),actor,captured_handle=binding.handle)
        except ProxyError:raise Refused('managed network reservation changed') from None
        owner_lock=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(('of-'+str(payload['ownerId'])).encode()).digest()[:8],'big',signed=True)
        s.execute(text('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(:key)'),{'key':owner_lock})
        duplicate=s.scalar(select(OfProviderConnection.account_id).where(
            OfProviderConnection.owner_id==payload['ownerId'],OfProviderConnection.account_id!=account).limit(1))
        if duplicate is not None:raise Refused('provider owner is already registered to another account')
        row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
        if row is not None and row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
        if (row.revision if row else 0)!=expected_revision:raise Refused('connection revision conflict')
        if row is not None and row.owner_id!=payload['ownerId']:raise Refused('connection owner cannot change')
        policy=s.get(OfDeliveryPolicy,account)
        if policy and (policy.active_intent_id or policy.queued_count):raise Refused('delivery must be quiescent before replacing credentials')
        revision=expected_revision+1
        if row is None:
            row=OfProviderConnection(account_id=account,binding_id=runtime.binding_id,owner_id=payload['ownerId'])
            s.add(row)
        row.revision=revision;row.sealed_config=_seal(payload,tenant,account,runtime.binding_id,revision)
        row.expires_at=expires.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None);row.status='pending'
        row.verified_at=None;row.last_error=None;row.updated_at=utcnow();runtime.enabled=False;runtime.recovery_needed=True
        row.automate_new_conversations=False;row.automation_starts_at=None
        if policy:policy.enabled=False;policy.revision+=1
        _audit(s,row,command_key,actor,action,fingerprint)
        from .launch_engagement.service import invalidate
        invalidate(s,runtime,reason='connection_changed',actor=actor)
    store.begin_scan(tenant,account)
    return revision

def change_connection(store,tenant,account,*,action,payload,expected_revision,command_key,actor):
    _validate_identity(command_key,actor,expected_revision)
    if action not in {'activate','pause','verify'} or type(payload) is not dict:raise Refused('invalid connection action')
    if action=='activate':
        if (not {'limitUnits','throttleSeconds','mediaEnabled'}<=set(payload) or not set(payload)<={'limitUnits','throttleSeconds','mediaEnabled','automateNewConversations'}
            or type(payload.get('automateNewConversations',False)) is not bool or type(payload['limitUnits']) is not int
            or not 1<=payload['limitUnits']<=10000 or type(payload['throttleSeconds']) is not int
            or not 1<=payload['throttleSeconds']<=86400 or type(payload['mediaEnabled']) is not bool):raise Refused('invalid delivery limits')
        from .send_gap import below_floor
        if below_floor(payload['throttleSeconds']):raise Refused('invalid delivery limits: send gap is under the shared 10 second floor')
    elif payload:raise Refused('invalid connection action payload')
    fingerprint=_request(action,payload,expected_revision)
    with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
        runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account);row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
        if row is not None and row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
        if action=='activate' and payload.get('automateNewConversations',False):
            raise Refused('use the future conversations setting; activation never arms it')
        prior=s.get(OfConnectionChange,(account,command_key))
        if prior:
            if prior.request_hash!=fingerprint or prior.actor!=actor:raise Refused('connection idempotency conflict')
            return prior.revision
        if row is None or row.revision!=expected_revision:raise Refused('connection revision conflict')
        if action=='verify' and row.expires_at<=utcnow():raise Refused('replace expired connection credentials before verification')
        policy=s.get(OfDeliveryPolicy,account)
        if action=='activate':
            if row.status!='verified' or row.expires_at<=utcnow() or row.verified_at is None:raise Refused('verify the selected provider connection before activation')
            if policy and (policy.active_intent_id or policy.queued_count):raise Refused('delivery is unresolved')
            if policy and payload['limitUnits']<policy.used_units:raise Refused('used allowance cannot be reset')
            if policy is None:policy=OfDeliveryPolicy(account_id=account);s.add(policy);s.flush()
            before={name:getattr(policy,name) for name in ['enabled','limit_units','throttle_seconds','transport_kind','media_enabled']}
            if payload['throttleSeconds']>policy.throttle_seconds and policy.next_dispatch_at is not None:
                policy.next_dispatch_at=max(policy.next_dispatch_at,utcnow()+timedelta(seconds=payload['throttleSeconds']))
            policy.revision+=1;policy.enabled=True;policy.transport_kind='native'
            policy.limit_units=payload['limitUnits'];policy.throttle_seconds=payload['throttleSeconds'];policy.media_enabled=payload['mediaEnabled']
            after={name:getattr(policy,name) for name in before}
            s.add(OfDeliveryPolicyChange(account_id=account,revision=policy.revision,actor=actor,reason='Explicit dashboard account activation',before_json=canonical(before),after_json=canonical(after),created_at=utcnow()))
            runtime.enabled=True;runtime.recovery_needed=True
            row.automate_new_conversations=False;row.automation_starts_at=None   # activation never arms future conversations
        else:
            runtime.enabled=False
            if policy:policy.enabled=False;policy.revision+=1
            row.automate_new_conversations=False;row.automation_starts_at=None   # re-arming is an explicit act
            row.status='paused' if action=='pause' else 'pending';row.last_error=None
            if action=='verify':row.verified_at=None
        # Re-encrypt with the new revision used by authenticated associated data.
        clear=_open(row,tenant);row.revision+=1
        row.sealed_config=_seal(clear,tenant,account,runtime.binding_id,row.revision);row.updated_at=utcnow()
        _audit(s,row,command_key,actor,action,fingerprint)
        from .launch_engagement.service import invalidate
        invalidate(s,runtime,reason='connection_changed',actor=actor)
        revision=row.revision
    if action in {'verify','activate'}:store.begin_scan(tenant,account)
    return revision

def set_model_credential(store,tenant,account,*,model,expected_revision,command_key,actor):
    """Replace ONLY this account's own model credential inside its sealed connection.

    The session, proxy, verification and activation state are untouched; the revision advances because the
    sealed record is re-encrypted with it. A credential is never copied from another account: the value must be
    supplied for this account and is validated against the registry before it is stored. Nothing is returned
    that contains the key."""
    from onlyfans_read.agency_scope import actor_allowed
    if (type(command_key) is not str or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{64}',command_key) or not actor_allowed(actor)
        or type(expected_revision) is not int or not 0<=expected_revision<2**31-1):raise Refused('invalid connection command')
    if type(model) is not dict or set(model)!={'modelId','apiKey'}:raise Refused('invalid selected model credential')
    fingerprint=_request('model',{'modelId':model.get('modelId'),'keyHash':hashlib.sha256(str(model.get('apiKey')).encode()).hexdigest()},expected_revision)
    with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
        runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account);row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
        prior=s.get(OfConnectionChange,(account,command_key))
        if prior:
            if prior.request_hash!=fingerprint or prior.actor!=actor:raise Refused('connection idempotency conflict')
            return prior.revision
        if row is None or row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
        if row.revision!=expected_revision:raise Refused('connection revision conflict')
        clear=_open(row,tenant)
        try:
            from .provider_model import NativeProviderModel
            NativeProviderModel(account_id=account,model_id=model['modelId'],api_key=model['apiKey'],
                expires_at=row.expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        except Exception:raise Refused('invalid selected model credential') from None
        row.revision+=1
        row.sealed_config=_seal({**clear,'model':{'modelId':model['modelId'],'apiKey':model['apiKey']}},tenant,account,runtime.binding_id,row.revision)
        row.updated_at=utcnow()
        _audit(s,row,command_key,actor,'model',fingerprint)
        from .launch_engagement.service import invalidate
        invalidate(s,runtime,reason='connection_changed',actor=actor)
        return row.revision

def check_model_credential(store,tenant,account,*,transport=None,timeout=8.0):
    """Read-only key check against the provider's key endpoint. No tokens are generated and nothing is stored.

    Returns {'state': 'usable'|'rejected'|'no_credit'|'unavailable'|'unsupported'|'missing', 'code', 'remaining'?}."""
    import httpx
    from llm_client import _resolve
    with Session(store.engine) as s:
        runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account,lock=False);row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)

def load_worker_cohort(store,tenant,*,limit=32,after_account=None,stop=None,facts_reader=None,include_read_only=False):
    """Bounded keyset refresh; all HTTP happens outside DB transactions.

    The cursor describes scanned candidate IDs, including refused credentials,
    so a broken early account cannot starve later accounts. None means the end
    was reached and the next refresh starts again from the first cohort.
    """
    if os.environ.get('ONLYFANS_PROCESS_ROLE')!='worker':raise Refused('connection loading requires the worker role')
    if type(limit) is not int or not 1<=limit<=32:raise Refused('invalid worker account bound')
    if type(include_read_only) is not bool:raise Refused('invalid inbox loading mode')
    if (type(tenant) is not str or tenant=='deployment' or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(tenant)
        or after_account is not None and (type(after_account) is not str or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(after_account))):
        raise Refused('invalid worker account cursor or tenant')
    if stop is not None and stop.is_set():return [],after_account,0
    from .native_worker import WorkerAccount
    result=[]
    with Session(store.engine) as s:
        query=select(OfProviderConnection.account_id).join(OfCreatorBinding,OfCreatorBinding.id==OfProviderConnection.binding_id).where(
            OfCreatorBinding.tenant_id==tenant,OfCreatorBinding.channel=='onlyfans',OfCreatorBinding.revoked_at.is_(None),OfProviderConnection.status!='paused')
        def candidate_ids(cursor):
            selection=query.where(OfProviderConnection.account_id>cursor) if cursor is not None else query
            return s.scalars(selection.order_by(OfProviderConnection.account_id).limit(limit+1)).all()
        ids=candidate_ids(after_account)
        if not ids and after_account is not None:ids=candidate_ids(None)
    more=len(ids)>limit;ids=ids[:limit]
    scanned=0;last_scanned=after_account
    for account in ids:
        if stop is not None and stop.is_set():break
        scanned+=1;last_scanned=account
        generation=None;renewable=False;snapshot=None
        try:
            with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
                runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account);row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
                if row is None or row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id:raise Refused('scope unavailable')
                now=utcnow()
                renewable=(row.status in {'verified','expired'} and row.verified_at is not None
                    and row.last_error in {None,'provider_connection_check_retry'})
                if row.status not in {'pending','verified','expired'}:continue
                if row.expires_at<=now and not renewable:
                    row.status='expired';runtime.enabled=False;continue
                if row.status=='expired' and not renewable:continue
                clear=_open(row,tenant);generation=row.revision;snapshot=row.sealed_config
                policy=s.get(OfDeliveryPolicy,account);policy_revision=policy.revision if policy else 1
                status=row.status;expires=row.expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                check_due=renewable and (row.verified_at<=now-CONNECTION_CHECK_INTERVAL
                    or row.expires_at<=now+CONNECTION_CHECK_INTERVAL
                    or row.last_error=='provider_connection_check_retry')
                if ((status=='pending' or check_due) and row.last_error=='provider_connection_check_retry'
                        and row.updated_at>now-CONNECTION_RETRY_INTERVAL):
                    # A still-valid lease preserves activation intent; it does
                    # not permit inbox/model/send work to evade retry pacing.
                    continue
            # An elapsed local lease may only be used for this identity GET.
            # No history, media, model or delivery work receives this probe.
            probe_expiry=(utcnow()+timedelta(minutes=1)).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if check_due else expires
            transport=NativeProviderConnector(session_from_capture(account_id=account,owner_id=clear['ownerId'],policy_revision=policy_revision,
                capture=clear['capture'],x_hash=clear['xHash'],proxy_url=clear['proxyUrl'],expires_at=probe_expiry))
            if status=='pending' or check_due:
                if stop is not None and stop.is_set():break
                from .provider_read_budget import acquire,current,release,native_reader
                budget=check_error=None
                try:
                    if native_reader(transport):
                        budget=acquire(store,tenant,account,connection_revision=generation,kind='connection_check')
                    transport.verify_identity()
                    with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
                        runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account);row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
                        if (row is None or row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id or row.revision!=generation
                            or row.sealed_config!=snapshot or row.status!=status
                            or status=='pending' and row.expires_at<=utcnow()):continue
                        if budget is not None:current(store,tenant,budget,session=s)
                        if check_due:
                            expires=(utcnow()+CONNECTION_LEASE).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                            clear={**clear,'expiresAt':expires.isoformat()}
                            row.sealed_config=_seal(clear,tenant,account,runtime.binding_id,generation)
                            row.expires_at=expires.replace(tzinfo=None)
                            row.updated_at=utcnow()
                        row.status='verified';row.verified_at=utcnow();row.last_error=None
                except Exception as error:
                    check_error=error
                    raise
                finally:
                    if budget is not None:release(store,tenant,budget,retry_after=getattr(check_error,'retry_after',None),
                        rate_limited=isinstance(check_error,NativeRateLimitError))
                if check_due:
                    transport=NativeProviderConnector(session_from_capture(account_id=account,owner_id=clear['ownerId'],policy_revision=policy_revision,
                        capture=clear['capture'],x_hash=clear['xHash'],proxy_url=clear['proxyUrl'],expires_at=expires))
            elif status!='verified':continue
            if os.environ.get("ONLYFANS_AUTOMATIC_IMPORTS_ENABLED") == "1":
                from .automatic_imports import ensure_started
                ensure_started(store, tenant, account, connection_revision=generation)
            if facts_reader is not None:
                from .creator_facts import refresh
                try:refresh(store,tenant,account,facts_reader)
                except (Refused,ValueError,TypeError):pass
            # Verified connections can load inbox history without an AI key or
            # outgoing activation. Sending keeps its existing policy gate.
            with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
                runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account);row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account);policy=s.get(OfDeliveryPolicy,account)
                if (row is None or row.revision!=generation or row.binding_id!=runtime.binding_id
                    or row.status!='verified' or row.verified_at is None or row.expires_at<=utcnow()):continue
                outgoing=bool(runtime.enabled and policy is not None and policy.enabled
                    and policy.transport_kind=='native' and policy.revision==policy_revision)
            # This is the connection generation, distinct from delivery policy
            # revision. Every account-bound read retains this snapshot through
            # the shared provider lease and its atomic result commit.
            transport.connection_revision=generation
            if not outgoing:
                if include_read_only:result.append(WorkerAccount(account,None,transport,transport,generation))
                continue
            from .provider_model import NativeProviderModel
            model=clear['model'];model=NativeProviderModel(account_id=account,model_id=model['modelId'],api_key=model['apiKey'],expires_at=expires) if model else None
            result.append(WorkerAccount(account,model,transport,transport))
        except Refused:
            continue
        except SQLAlchemyError:
            raise
        except Exception as error:
            # Never put a provider response, exception URL or secret in health.
            with Session(store.engine) as s,s.begin():
                runtime=store._runtime(s,tenant,account);row=s.get(OfProviderConnection,account)
                if (row and generation is not None and row.revision==generation
                        and row.sealed_config==snapshot and row.status!='paused'):
                    if ((renewable or (row.status=='pending' and isinstance(error,NativeProtocolError)))
                            and not isinstance(error,NativeAuthenticationError)):
                        # A transient first verification must not strand a new
                        # connection. Retain its original capture deadline and
                        # pace retries; only verified leases may be renewed.
                        row.last_error='provider_connection_check_retry';row.updated_at=utcnow()
                    else:
                        row.status='failed';runtime.enabled=False
                        row.last_error='provider_authentication_required' if isinstance(error,NativeAuthenticationError) else 'provider_verification_failed'
    next_cursor=last_scanned if more or scanned<len(ids) else None
    return result,next_cursor,scanned

never permission to send. A delivery authority is a later integration gate.

def _id(value):
    if type(value) is not int or not 0 < value < 2**63:

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Event:
    fan_id: int
    message_id: int
    created_at: str
    direction: str
    body: str
    media_ids: tuple[int, ...] = ()
    price_cents: int = 0

    def normalized(self):
        _id(self.fan_id)
        _id(self.message_id)
        if self.direction not in {"in", "out"} or not isinstance(self.body, str) or len(self.body.encode()) > 20000:
            raise Refused("invalid message")
        if type(self.price_cents) is not int or not 0 <= self.price_cents <= 100_000_000:
            raise Refused("invalid integer money")
        if len(self.media_ids) > 100:
            raise Refused("too many media references")
        media = tuple(_id(v) for v in self.media_ids)
        try:
            date = datetime.fromisoformat(self.created_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except (ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
            raise Refused("invalid provider timestamp") from exc
        if date.tzinfo is None:
            raise Refused("provider timestamp must include timezone")
        stamp = date.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        return Event(self.fan_id, self.message_id, stamp, self.direction, self.body, media, self.price_cents)

    def payload(self):
        return json.dumps(asdict(self.normalized()), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
